system.flavor:
Keep watch on a doorway while your back is turned, know the moment someone touches your pack, catch a pickpocket's hand before it closes, sleep lightly enough that a footstep wakes you, or see through a street conjurer's misdirection.

Not enough to watch a whole camp or see through a real disguise.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self; choose a visible point within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, know when a creature enters within 1 unit of the point, even in ordinary darkness; gain +1 Composure against sensory deception.

surges.html: Increase the watched radius to 2 units.
Share the defensive benefit with an adjacent willing ally.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Vigilance (upkeep 0): replacing an Adaptation never blocks your awareness of detected creatures during the transformation; gain +1 Composure against distraction while transforming.
